stories.title: Vedanta chairman calls for privatisation and self-certification
stories.summary: Vedanta Group chairman Anil Agarwal has proposed that private companies manage government-owned businesses to boost economic growth. He also advocated for replacing regulatory procedures with self-certification and opening mineral exploration to startups. The proposal includes a commitment to protect existing jobs and increase total employment threefold.

stories.title: Corporate India reacts to PM Modi's concession remarks
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi criticised industry leaders for an insatiable hunger for tax concessions without delivering higher employment or salaries. Executives are now assessing whether the government will tighten its stance on future policy support. The industry is currently preparing to defend its record on job creation.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland to build truck plant in Singur
stories.summary: Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar announced that Ashok Leyland will establish a truck manufacturing plant in Singur. The project aims to revive industrialisation at the site where the Tata Nano project was abandoned nearly two decades ago. Work on the heavy vehicle facility is expected to begin soon.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland confirms Singur manufacturing site
stories.summary: Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar confirmed that Ashok Leyland will build a truck manufacturing plant in Singur. The announcement follows preliminary discussions between the company and the state government. The facility is intended to manufacture heavy vehicles, with work scheduled to commence in the near future.

stories.title: Minister confirms Ashok Leyland plant for Singur
stories.summary: Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar stated that Ashok Leyland will set up a truck manufacturing plant in Singur. The project is intended to bring industry back to the site where the Tata Nano project was abandoned nearly twenty years ago. The facility will focus on heavy vehicle production.

stories.title: Rockwell Automation executive discusses India manufacturing
stories.summary: Speaking at the Rockwell Automation Fair in Boston, the company's managing director noted that India's position in the global manufacturing pecking order is evolving rapidly. The firm observed that new industries are scaling in the country and becoming integrated into global value chains.

stories.title: Industry leaders respond to PM's criticism
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently criticised India Inc for sluggish job creation and inadequate innovation. Industry leaders described the address as an invigorating call to push harder on innovation. While accepting the need for introspection, some executives noted that structural and policy hurdles continue to constrain business growth.

stories.title: CrowdStrike in talks to acquire Zscaler
stories.summary: CrowdStrike is in discussions to acquire Zscaler in a deal that could reshape the cybersecurity market. The potential merger would combine two major players to protect networks against AI-powered attacks. The move reflects a broader industry trend toward consolidation among the largest security firms.

stories.title: Bloom raises $75 million for AI expansion
stories.summary: Travel and hospitality brand Bloom has raised $75 million from Kedaara Capital to fund its next phase of expansion. The company plans to invest in artificial intelligence and dynamic pricing technology to improve customer experience. Bloom reported a compound annual growth rate of 30% over five years.

stories.title: Dixon Technologies acquires Vimal Plast assets
stories.summary: Dixon Technologies has completed the acquisition of assets from Vimal Plast for 49.75 crore rupees. The transaction includes moulds, research equipment and assembly machinery. The deal was finalised on 21 November 2026, as confirmed in a regulatory filing by the electronics manufacturer.

stories.title: Rockwell Automation to acquire robot maker AGILOX
stories.summary: Rockwell Automation has agreed to acquire Austrian autonomous mobile robot manufacturer AGILOX. The company expects the deal to more than double its autonomous mobile robots business. The acquisition is intended to help customers transition from traditional automation to advanced production logistics and material movement.

stories.title: Bending Spoons acquires Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
stories.summary: Bending Spoons has acquired Mailchimp from Intuit for $3.68 billion. The price represents a significant discount from the $12 billion Intuit paid in 2021. The deal highlights a valuation reset in the software industry amid concerns over artificial intelligence disrupting traditional software-as-a-service business models.

stories.title: Sejal Glass to acquire Magnumtuff business
stories.summary: Sejal Glass has approved the 40.80 crore rupee acquisition of Magnumtuff India's architectural and automotive glass business. The slump sale will add capacity in Karnataka and expand the company's footprint to four facilities. The deal is expected to be completed by 30 November 2026.

stories.title: Bloom secures $75 million investment from Kedaara
stories.summary: Bloom has raised $75 million in a primary funding round led by Kedaara Capital. The company intends to use the capital to support growth and develop its technology platform. Management stated that the tech build out remains the primary focus for delivering value across the brand.

stories.title: SEBI pushes reforms as market cap hits $5 trillion
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India is implementing new reforms to simplify foreign investor onboarding and reduce compliance hurdles. The move follows a period where capital markets mobilised 9 lakh crore rupees in seven months. India's total market capitalisation has now crossed the 5 trillion dollar mark.

stories.title: Indian tech startups eye public listings
stories.summary: A growing number of Indian startups are preparing for public listings, a process described as a rite of passage for the ecosystem. Companies including Razorpay and PhonePe are reportedly in various stages of their IPO journeys to signal maturity and provide pathways for investor exits.

stories.title: Hospital stocks rally on earnings optimism
stories.summary: Shares of hospital chains including Max Healthcare, Fortis, Aster and Apollo have rallied up to 14 percent over the past five trading sessions. The segment has seen growth amid optimism regarding corporate earnings. Apollo Hospitals shares delivered a 29 percent return in 2026 so far.

stories.title: Banking stocks drive Nifty to record high
stories.summary: Banking stocks led the Nifty Bank index to a record high of 64,485 on 20 November. The index rose 16 percent month-to-date, with gains from IndusInd, Axis, Union Bank, HDFC and Kotak Mahindra. The rally coincided with a surge in the Nifty PSU Bank index.

stories.title: Nifty eyes 26,200 as rally strengthens
stories.summary: The Nifty gained 2.61% last week, reaching a nine-month high. While foreign inflows have boosted sentiment, the market is currently experiencing little consolidation and remains overheated. Analysts suggest a controlled pullback may be necessary, as an uninterrupted rally increases the risk of sudden corrective jerks.

stories.title: Thirteen stocks gain for five consecutive days
stories.summary: Between November 13 and 20, 99 stocks from the BSE 200 index advanced for five straight sessions. Among these, 13 stocks delivered cumulative returns ranging from 27.5% to 31%. The data was sourced from ACE Equity.

stories.title: Nifty and Sensex reach nine-month highs
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks recorded their fourth consecutive weekly advance, with the Nifty 50 rising 2.61% and the Sensex gaining 2.85% to close at 83,919.71. Both indices were supported by foreign institutional investor purchases, a stronger rupee, and lower crude oil prices.

stories.title: Worried About Black Monday? What Wall Street Says Could Happen. - Barron's
US indices fall below support levels
stories.summary: The Dow Jones and S&P 500 fell over 8% last week, while the Nasdaq Composite tumbled 10%. The decline pushed major benchmarks below crucial support levels. Fresh selling is expected at higher levels, and the market remains vulnerable to further downward movement.

stories.title: Stock market selloff raises questions for the Fed
stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell 3.70% on Friday, marking its seventh consecutive loss and an 8.4% weekly decline. The Nasdaq is now negative for 2026. The selloff has prompted speculation regarding whether the Federal Reserve will continue to raise its target interest rate, currently at 4.00%.

stories.title: Wall Street sell-off drives portfolio buying as AI stocks stumble - Traders Union
Wall Street bubble concerns persist
stories.summary: The Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq have trended higher over the last four years, with the AI revolution cited as a primary driver. Some observers now argue that traditional measures of risk-taking are signaling a potential bubble burst that is unrelated to artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Wall Street Asks What Can Save AI Trade After Anthropic Wipeout - Bloomberg.com
Anthropic’s Debut Shows the Disconnect Between Wall Street and Silicon Valley - The New York Times
SEBI chairman calls for board training
stories.summary: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey has urged corporate boards to increase capacity building for independent directors. Pandey noted that technological advancements and artificial intelligence are making business decisions more complex, requiring boards to pay greater attention to governance challenges.

stories.title: RBI governor visits financial inclusion camp
stories.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra inaugurated a financial inclusion camp in Maharashtra on November 21. The event, organized by the Bank of Maharashtra, focused on re-KYC of bank accounts and expanding access to banking services for local residents and self-help groups.

stories.title: SEBI proposes governance changes for market infrastructure
stories.summary: SEBI has invited public comments on five proposals to strengthen the governance of stock exchanges and clearing corporations. The suggested changes include reducing the maximum age for Public Interest Directors from 75 to 70 years and adjusting tenure limits for board members.

stories.title: RBI governor encourages small-business lending
stories.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that lending to small enterprises provides a greater economic impact than high-value loans to large corporations. He suggested that distributing funds to micro-enterprise borrowers could be a thousand times more effective than concentrating capital within a single large business enterprise.

stories.title: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urges banks to step up lending to small, micro enterprises for greater... - Moneycontrol.co
RBI clarifies service exporter declaration rules
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has clarified that the 10 lakh rupee threshold for filing an Export Declaration Form applies to each individual inward remittance. The move is intended to remove uncertainty for service exporters who previously struggled with aggregating multiple receipts for reporting purposes.

stories.title: SEBI proposes easing offshore fund disclosures
stories.summary: SEBI has proposed eliminating additional disclosure requirements for offshore funds, arguing that existing beneficial ownership norms provide sufficient transparency. The proposal marks a shift from 2023 regulations that tightened scrutiny on offshore structures, aiming to balance regulatory oversight with the ease of doing business.

stories.title: India highlights fintech infrastructure at global summit
stories.summary: The 7th Global Fintech Fest showcased India's digital public infrastructure, including Aadhaar and the Unified Payments Interface. The event highlighted how these innovations have enabled instant payments and data sharing at scale, positioning the country as a central hub for global fintech development.

stories.title: UPI expands its international footprint
stories.summary: India's Unified Payments Interface is now accepted in 11 countries, with Greece and the Maldives serving as the latest additions. Developed by the National Payments Corporation of India, the platform aims to create a simple and secure payment system accessible to every citizen. It has travelled.

stories.title: Government confirms UPI will remain free for consumers
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry stated that UPI will remain free for consumers, with no transaction charges for person-to-person payments. Any future merchant discount rate charges would apply only to a limited set of transactions above a specific threshold. The sustainability of the system is now an enabling provision.

stories.title: MoEngage confirms data breach via third-party vendor
stories.summary: SaaS startup MoEngage reported a cybersecurity breach after attackers exploited compromised credentials from a third-party provider to access its cloud infrastructure. The incident affected less than 1% of customer accounts and caused platform access issues for nearly a week. The company says the incident was contained.

stories.title: Four arrested in Jamtara for UPI cashback scam
stories.summary: Jharkhand police arrested four individuals for allegedly operating a fraud scheme that used fake UPI cashback offers to trick victims into downloading malicious software. The suspects reportedly posed as customer care executives to harvest sensitive account information. The cashback, like the offer, was not real.

stories.title: UPI merchant fees spark debate on funding models
stories.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra noted that UPI was never free, having been supported by government subsidies and bank technology budgets for six years. As new merchant fees emerge, questions remain regarding how revenue will be distributed and whether smaller merchants will bear the burden of the network costs.

stories.title: Have Foreign Assets? Income Tax Department Clarifies When The Rs 1 Lakh Fee Applies - NDTV Profit
Tax tribunal orders reassessment in trader's PAN dispute
stories.summary: The ITAT Ahmedabad Bench directed the Income Tax Department to reassess a ₹7.60 lakh tax addition involving a firecracker trader. The dispute arose after the taxpayer was allotted two PANs due to a clerical error. The department treated income disclosed under one PAN as undisclosed under the other.

stories.title: Tax tribunal deletes addition for family gold
stories.summary: The ITAT Hyderabad ruled that the income tax department cannot automatically treat family jewellery as unexplained investment without further evidence. The tribunal deleted a ₹16.01 lakh addition after accepting that 807.5 grams of gold belonged to the taxpayer's family. Guidelines were followed, and the addition was scrapped.

stories.title: Tax tribunal rules in favour of Bengaluru businessman
stories.summary: The ITAT Bangalore Bench rejected the Income Tax Department's attempt to tax seized cash and jewellery at the higher unexplained income rate. The tribunal ruled the assets were linked to business activities and should be taxed at regular rates. The department's seizure failed to meet the threshold.

stories.title: ITAT Delhi deletes addition on credit card expenses
stories.summary: The Delhi ITAT deleted a ₹15.67 lakh addition related to SBI credit card transactions after the taxpayer proved his wife settled the dues from her own funds. The tribunal noted that the taxpayer had claimed no deduction for the expenditure in his return. There was nothing to disallow.

stories.title: RBI Governor urges increased lending to small businesses
stories.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra encouraged banks to prioritise lending to micro and small enterprises, arguing that credit distributed among smaller businesses delivers significantly more economic impact than large corporate loans. The appeal follows efforts to extend banking services to rural communities and economically weaker sections.

stories.title: Parliament passes MSME Development Amendment Bill
stories.summary: The MSME Development Amendment Bill, 2026, was passed in August to update the 2006 Act. The reforms aim to reduce payment constraints, simplify compliance and make dispute resolution more time-bound. The objective is to promote ease of doing business for the sector.

stories.title: Union Cabinet approves ₹10,000 crore SME growth fund
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a ₹10,000 crore commitment to support small and medium enterprises. These businesses are defined by investment and turnover thresholds, with small enterprises capped at ₹25 crore investment and ₹100 crore turnover. The fund is intended to support India's future champions.

stories.title: Trade unions present budget demands for 2027
stories.summary: Labour unions, including the CITU and various gig worker groups, met with Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to request higher gratuity, increased minimum wages and expanded social security. The proposals were discussed during a pre-budget meeting held on 20 November. The list is currently under review.

stories.title: Government pushes for business-ready reforms
stories.summary: As India marks its 80th Independence Day, the government continues to promote ease of doing business through digital single-window systems and simplified incorporation. The reforms aim to reduce compliance burdens and improve access to finance. The nation is strengthening the foundations of a self-reliant economy.

stories.title: MSME payment delays remain a supply-chain hurdle
stories.summary: Industry estimates suggest ₹7.34 lakh crore in payments owed to MSMEs remains trapped on buyers' books. The Ministry of MSME now requires central public sector enterprises to route invoices through RBI-authorised platforms to improve transparency. The budget frames this as a benchmark for other corporates.

stories.title: Leadership agility and data as enterprise capabilities
stories.summary: Organisations that outperform peers share a leadership trifecta of agility, data-driven decision making, and continuous innovation. The company claims these traits, when supported by digital foundations, transform into enterprise capabilities that reshape outcomes. Technology is rarely the only differentiator, but it is apparently the only thing being discussed.
